en-US.title: Sidequest
en-US.subtitle: Your backlog, minus the guilt
en-US.description:
Sidequest is for the adult who still loves games and has almost no time left for them. You own hundreds. You get forty-five minutes after bedtime. Sidequest tells you what you can actually finish, and gives you permission to let the rest go.

TONIGHT
One decision, made for you: the game that fits the evening you actually have, with how far you are through it and how many evenings are left. Open the app, read one line, go and play.

THE PLAN
Set your pace, or connect Steam and let your real hours set it for you. Sidequest reads how long each game takes and lays your library across the weeks ahead: what fits, what's on the edge, and what was never going to fit — said plainly, so you can drop it without guilt.

CONNECT STEAM
Paste your profile and your library arrives with hours played, so progress and pace are measured instead of guessed. No password, no login through us: Steam's public API only.

MY LIBRARY
A shelf, not a to-do list. Sort games into ahead, playing and finished; add notes, tags, ratings and deadlines; import a CSV; correct any game's length and Sidequest will use your number.

WIDGETS
Tonight's pick on your Home Screen and Lock Screen. This week as an agenda of evenings. The month as a horizon with deadlines drawn as weather. The year as your Memcard. They never go online — the app writes the plan, the widgets read it.

YOUR MEMCARD
Every finished game fills one block on a memory card, stamped ROLL CREDITS. Share the year, or the month, as one image.

ALSO
• Evenings written into a calendar of their own, if you want them there
• Reminders for a planned evening or a deadline — sparse by design
• Trailers, screenshots, live streams and store links for every game
• Backlog amnesty: archive the pile in one tap
• Works entirely without an account. Sign in only if you want your library and plan on another device; delete the account from the app whenever you like

Game data from RAWG, IGDB, Steam, SteamGridDB and Twitch.

review.notes:
Sidequest is a game backlog planner. Nothing in the app is gated behind an account: the home screen, search, every game page, the library, the plan and the widgets all work signed out, so no demo credentials are needed.

Sign-in exists only to sync the library to another device. It offers Sign in with Apple, Google, and an emailed magic link (there is no password sign-in, so no demo password exists). To exercise it, use Sign in with Apple with any Apple ID: You tab → Account → Continue with Apple. Account deletion is on the same screen: Account → Delete account → Delete for good. It deletes the account and all synced data on the server immediately.

To see the plan with real data: The Plan tab → Connect Steam → paste a Steam profile URL or vanity name whose game details are public, for example REPLACE_WITH_PUBLIC_STEAM_VANITY. Or simply save a few games from the home screen and set a pace on The Plan; Tonight and the week fill in immediately.

Widgets: after saving a few games and opening The Plan once, add the Sidequest widgets (Tonight, This week, This month, The year) from the Home Screen widget gallery.

Calendar and notification permissions are requested only when the user asks for those features (The Plan → calendar / reminders), never at launch.

Game titles, artwork and video are licensed third-party data from the RAWG, IGDB, Steam, SteamGridDB and Twitch APIs, used under their API terms with attribution in the app.
